items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: And Tony Parenti, a little parent, he used to play with the orchestra, he used to play the other stuff, you know.

ctx.x: Did you ever see this book called They All Played Ragtime? No, I did not. Well, let's look at this third paragraph here. Tony Perrini, the New Orleans clarinet player.
Tony's still living, I think. He's in Chicago. No, he's in New York.
Last time I talked to him... Oh, that's right.
